kinds.d: Cloth flag made to fly from a pole or bracket or hang from a stand.
Tall narrow flag on a curved pole with a ground spike or base, made to stand outside as a sign or decoration.
Windsock or streamer made as a garden or festive ornament rather than to show wind direction.
Pole made to fly a flag.

notes: Restraint-only: National flag, State or territory flag, Garden flag and House flag (k77-k80) merged into one Flag kind with those four as types (source kept from k77). Pennant, Feather banner, Decorative windsock and Flagpole kept kind-level with old sources. No models in old data; none added. Audit code K-192 removed from Flagpole definition.
